function.name: transferir_fondos
function.description: This tool allows users to transfer funds from their wallet to a contact or wallet they provide. They can transfer to a phone number (same-chain), to a wallet address on another EVM/Solana/Bitcoin network (cross-chain), or to a Cardano address on the Cardano network. They need to specify the amount, recipient, token type, and optionally the destination network and token.

to.description: Recipient: a wa_id (phone number) for same-chain transfers, a wallet address for cross-chain transfers (EVM 0x address, Solana base58 address, or Bitcoin address), or a Cardano bech32 address (starts with "addr1" on mainnet, "addr_test1" on testnet) when the network is Cardano.

token.description: Name of the token the user wants to transfer.

destination_token.description: Token symbol on the destination chain if different from source token. Omit to keep the same token.

network.description: Destination network. Use the literal string "cardano" when the user is sending ADA or any Cardano native token; in that case the transfer is same-chain on Cardano, not a bridge. For cross-chain EVM/Solana/Bitcoin transfers use the chain key ("eth", "arb", "pol", "sol", "btc"). Omit for same-chain EVM transfers.
